tools.name: discover_4h_setups
tools.description: List the four independently purchasable market setups and TZ SELECT, which selects at most one of those setups per 4H cycle.

tools.name: prepare_4h_setup_purchase
tools.description: Return the exact paid resource URL, price ceiling and wallet steps for one complete setup. The wallet-enabled agent signs and retries the returned HTTPS request; this tool never moves funds.

tools.name: get_performance_evidence
tools.description: Read the current public live-simulation evidence for closed setups selected by Trading Zones Selector. The rate does not describe every non-selected market package.

tools.name: prepare_btc_4h_purchase
tools.description: Return the exact paid URL and wallet steps for the independent BTC 4H setup. No funds move until the wallet or user authorizes the x402 request.

tools.name: prepare_eth_4h_purchase
tools.description: Return the exact paid URL and wallet steps for the independent ETH 4H setup. No funds move until the wallet or user authorizes the x402 request.

tools.name: prepare_xrp_4h_purchase

tools.name: prepare_ondo_4h_purchase

tools.name: prepare_tz_select_4h_purchase
tools.description: Return the exact paid URL and wallet steps for the independent TZ SELECT 4H setup. No funds move until the wallet or user authorizes the x402 request.

tools.name: get_btc_4h_setup
tools.description: Purchase and return the complete current BTC 4H setup inside this MCP tool call. On the first call the tool returns x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with _meta['x402/payment']. A successful response includes _meta['x402/payment-response'].
